sections.Profile:
King Tut , released by Bally in 1969, is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Ted Zale with artwork by Dick White. It features an Egyptian theme with 2 flippers, 4 pop bumpers, mushroom bumpers, and 5 stand-up targets. Its add-a-ball counterpart, King Rex , was released in 1970 with similar gameplay but different artwork.
